Get original variable names from an S7 model or stanfit input object

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-stanfit-input-methods.R, R/S7-stanfit-methods.R
get_data.Rd

Retrieves the original variable names that were mapped to standard roles ("group", "group_unique", "category", "response_category", and "cues") when the model or input object was created.

Retrieves underlying experimental data (all observations across phases, exposure observations only, or test observations only) stored in an S7 MVBU_Stanfit, IdealAdaptorStanfitInput, or MVBU_StanfitPosterior object.

Usage

get_original_variable_names(
  x,
  variable = c("group", "group_unique", "category", "response_category", "cues"),
  ...
)

get_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  response_categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

get_exposure_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

get_test_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  response_categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <IdealAdaptorStanfitInput>
get_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  response_categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <IdealAdaptorStanfitInput>
get_exposure_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <IdealAdaptorStanfitInput>
get_test_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  response_categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_original_variable_names(
  x,
  variable = c("group", "group_unique", "category", "response_category", "cues"),
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  response_categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_exposure_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_test_data(
  x,
  space = c("original", "transformed"),
  groups = NULL,
  response_categories = NULL,
  n_samples = NULL,
  original_names = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An S7 stanfit, stanfit-input, or stanfit-posterior object.

variable

Character vector subsetting the variable types to retrieve. Must be one or more of "group", "group_unique", "category", "response_category", or "cues". Defaults to all of them.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

space

Character string indicating which cue space to return: "original" (default) or "transformed".

groups

Optional character vector of group labels to filter observations by. Defaults to all available groups.

categories

Optional character vector of category labels to filter exposure observations by. Defaults to all available category levels.

response_categories

Optional character vector of response category labels to filter test observations by. Defaults to all available response category levels.

n_samples

Optional integer; subsample up to n_samples rows. Defaults to NULL (all observations).

original_names

Logical; if TRUE, renames standardized columns back to original variable names. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named list of character vectors (or a character vector if a single variable is requested) containing the original variable names.

A tibble containing the requested data.

See also

get_data, get_exposure_data, get_test_data

get_original_variable_names

Examples

sfi <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input()
get_original_variable_names(sfi)
#> $group
#> [1] "group"
#> 
#> $group_unique
#> [1] "group"
#> 
#> $category
#> [1] "category"
#> 
#> $response_category
#> [1] "response_category"
#> 
#> $cues
#> [1] "VOT"
#> 
head(get_data(sfi))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   group        group_unique category response_category     VOT Phase   
#>   <fct>        <fct>        <fct>    <chr>               <dbl> <fct>   
#> 1 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                  1.06  exposure
#> 2 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                 -0.317 exposure
#> 3 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                -18.4   exposure
#> 4 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                  6.77  exposure
#> 5 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                -15.4   exposure
#> 6 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                 -8.59  exposure
head(get_exposure_data(sfi))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   group        group_unique category response_category     VOT Phase   
#>   <fct>        <fct>        <fct>    <chr>               <dbl> <fct>   
#> 1 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                  1.06  exposure
#> 2 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                 -0.317 exposure
#> 3 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                -18.4   exposure
#> 4 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                  6.77  exposure
#> 5 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                -15.4   exposure
#> 6 left_shifted left_shifted /d/      NA                 -8.59  exposure
head(get_test_data(sfi))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   group       group_unique category response_category   VOT Phase
#>   <fct>       <fct>        <fct>    <chr>             <dbl> <fct>
#> 1 no_exposure no_exposure  NA       /d/                13.8 test 
#> 2 no_exposure no_exposure  NA       /d/                13.8 test 
#> 3 no_exposure no_exposure  NA       /d/                13.8 test 
#> 4 no_exposure no_exposure  NA       /d/                13.8 test 
#> 5 no_exposure no_exposure  NA       /d/                13.8 test 
#> 6 no_exposure no_exposure  NA       /d/                13.8 test
